COMPRESS. RELEASE. COMPARE.

Find the rebound.

A loaded axial spring and damper. Inspect preload, compression and rebound before assembling the whole bicycle.

Element setup

ILLUSTRATIVE

Synthetic fixtures, not named products. Shock stroke is axial stroke, not rear-wheel travel. Presets replace all setup fields; Apply to calculate.

Positive velocity compresses; negative extends. Zero velocity releases the spring from rest relative to the base.

Run and solver settings

Recording interval must divide duration and contain whole integration steps. Refine the step to check convergence.

Model assumptions

A guided mass above a prescribed base. One preloaded linear coil with separate viscous compression/rebound damping. Total axial force can be negative on rebound. No friction, air chambers, linkage leverage or end-stop dynamics.

A trial outside stroke stops the run and retains its last valid endpoint. This is a model limit, not a calculated top-out or bottom-out impact. Equilibrium must lie strictly inside stroke.
